notes: All four documents were coded delegates by both coders. Unit disagreements: (1) phase labels (during-work vs general, before-course vs general or course-start or over-time) for institutional recommendations and data rules, resolved by treating set-up and provisioning as before-course and principles as general; (2) modality (should vs must vs informs), resolved by treating Best Practices advice and non-binding principles as should and obligations as must; (3) policy_type for general statements (P35/P41/P56 for the integrity-goal line, P04/P56 for departmental guidelines, P51/P17 for free tools, P63/P35 for teaching guidance, P56/P65 for standard-setting, P09/UNCOVERED for vignettes), settled by re-reading the sentence and choosing the type whose definition it states; (4) unit_stance, where require/encourage/restrict were replaced by permit or neutral per the codebook convention. Coder A merged two student rules in one unit; split in the final. Coder B-only units kept: 13; dropped: 5 (survey statistics and group charge). Coder A-only units kept: 2.
